bullets.body: Alibaba's Qwen3.6-Max-Preview-235B Mixture-of-Experts checkpoint landed on OpenRouter on Thursday morning Pacific time, hitting the May 28 calendar catalyst that Decrypt cited in its May 26 model-card coverage as the scheduled integration cycle. OpenRouter co-founder Alex Atallah confirmed in a Thursday product note that the integration ships with five hosted-provider endpoints active at launch (Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, Together AI, Fireworks AI, Hyperbolic, and a newly-added DeepInfra slot), routing across the cohort with a default lowest-price-first policy at the $0.45 per million input token Model Studio floor — undercutting DeepSeek-V4-Pro at $1.10 and Anthropic Claude Opus 4.7 at $7.50. The first-six-hour routing telemetry that OpenRouter published Thursday afternoon shows Qwen3.6-Max-Preview-235B picking up roughly 4.7 percent of total OpenRouter completion volume across all listed models (the third-highest first-day share for any new model on the gateway, behind only GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.7), with median first-token latency holding at 0.16 seconds across the five-provider pool and the routing-policy default landing approximately 73 percent of requests on Together AI plus Fireworks AI on the back of their FP8 quantization tier. Hugging Face's Thursday hosted-endpoint dashboard separately recorded the model crossing 1.04 million completion requests in the first eight hours of OpenRouter availability, and Simon Willison flagged the integration as the first Chinese frontier-open MoE checkpoint to land on OpenRouter inside its scheduled vendor-announced calendar window without slippage.

bullets.body: Cerebras Systems (NASDAQ: CBRS) closed Thursday at $231.40, up 2.9 percent from Wednesday's $224.85 print and lifting the stock to a fresh all-time intraday high of $234.85 inside the cash session, on volume of approximately 19.2 million shares. The state-change driving the Thursday tape was a Morgan Stanley initiation note from analyst Joseph Moore moving from his prior pre-coverage stance to a formal Buy rating with a $250 twelve-month target, paired with a JPMorgan initiation from analyst Harlan Sur at Overweight with a $255 target — both desks citing the Wednesday Goldman Sachs and Citi prints as the cohort-coordination signal that resolved the customer-concentration objection that had kept their pre-coverage notes in committee since the IPO. Reuters reported the Thursday close pushed the formal-coverage Buy/Buy-equivalent count to four of the top-ten sell-side desks (Goldman Sachs, Citi, Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan), with the consensus twelve-month target band tightening to $245-$260; institutional buyside cumulative net position lifted to approximately 51.4 percent of float on the Thursday tape from Wednesday's 49.8 percent — the first reading above the half-of-float threshold conventionally flagging a graduation from hedge-fund-rotation to long-only-anchored holding. Bloomberg separately reported that the S&P Dow Jones Indices methodology committee opened a formal eligibility-review consultation for S&P Total Market Index inclusion with a 30-day comment window closing June 27, citing the institutional-float threshold and the post-IPO trading-day count as the trigger criteria.

bullets.body: Mistral AI shipped a Thursday emergency security advisory disclosing CVE-2026-46341, a high-severity (CVSS 8.4) prompt-injection-escalation vulnerability in the Mistral Workflows orchestrator's tool-call deserialization path on the v1.18.x branch — the same JSON-Schema validation gap class that Trail of Bits and Pillar Security surfaced in OpenAI Codex CLI on Tuesday and Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 on Wednesday — making this the third agentic-orchestrator vendor inside a single trading week to ship a patch against the structurally-identical CVE pattern. Mistral's advisory credits an internal red-team finding that emerged after the team audited the analogous workflow-tool deserialization path against the prior two disclosures; a patched v1.18.7 stable tag shipped inside the same Thursday window adding strict schema validation plus the same runtime tool-call audit log primitive, and Mistral's note states all sovereign-cloud central-government reference tenants will be force-rolled inside 24 hours under the EU Cyber Resilience Act notification window. CISA placed CVE-2026-46341 on the KEV catalog Thursday afternoon after Mandiant confirmed a third Fortune 500 incident-response engagement — this time at a Fortune 500 industrial-manufacturing customer — taking the Trail of Bits agentic-AI tooling-stack CVE taxonomy to fourteen catalogued instances and the cohort vertical-count to three (financial services, healthcare, industrial manufacturing). The Hacker News separately reported the FFIEC interagency cohort (OCC, Federal Reserve Board, FDIC, NCUA, CFPB) issued a same-day joint statement flagging that the second-consecutive-trading-week confirmed-exploitation pattern across three vendors meets the booklet-addendum threshold its Tuesday outsourced-technology examination note had identified — accelerating the prior Q3 2026 expected guidance timeline to an early-July formal addendum draft.

bullets.body: NVIDIA disclosed in a Thursday investor-relations 8-K filing that the Vera Rubin platform's NVL576-rack production-volume window has been pulled forward by approximately five weeks — from the prior H1 2027 target to a late-February 2027 target — citing TSMC CoWoS-L capacity allocation that was renegotiated inside the May 19 supply-chain consultation cycle. The filing names the first-batch engineering-sample allocation cohort across five lead customers (Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, AWS, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, and CoreWeave) with the second batch (Meta, OpenAI, Lambda Labs, Anthropic) now lifting from a Q1 2027 target to a mid-January 2027 target and the third batch (Apple, Crusoe Cloud, xAI, Mistral AI, Cohere) holding at H1 2027. AMD's parallel Thursday 8-K filed inside the same intra-day window confirmed its Helios MI450 commitment book lifted to 10.7GW (from Wednesday's 10.1GW print) with three fresh sovereign-cloud commitments — South Korea's KT Cloud at 0.2GW, Japan's KDDI Cloud at 0.2GW, and India's Yotta Labs at 0.2GW — taking the Indo-Pacific allied-tier commitment count to nine cloud operators across the framework. Datacenter Dynamics reported the dual 8-K cadence crystallized what Wall Street's AI-accelerator-pure-play cohort had been characterizing all week as a duopoly-forward-cadence and that Tenstorrent's confidential S-1 review is on track for an early-August public filing under the JOBS Act EGC framework — with SambaNova's six-bookrunner roster confirmed by Reuters to be filing late-June ahead of a Q3 2026 IPO target.

bullets.body: Mistral AI announced Thursday morning the general-availability cut of its five-vendor cross-orchestrator interop matrix — Mistral Workflows plus OpenAI Codex CLI plus Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 plus Microsoft Azure AI Foundry Skill Catalog plus Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Center — landing two weeks ahead of the prior first-week-of-June target that the May 14 InfoQ note had publicly committed to. The GA cut ships with three operational features the orchestrator-cohort treats as the canonical cross-vendor baseline: (1) a signed-checkpoint-manifest verification surface that defaults to sigstore cosign signature chains under the joint DeepMind-Meta AI-Anthropic-Microsoft May 11 preprint reference implementation; (2) a fifteen-jurisdiction tenant-policy reciprocity attestation schema covering the Indo-Pacific cohort plus the Gulf observer tier (Saudi Arabia and Qatar exploratory entries); and (3) a conformance test suite that ran green on a ten-document end-to-end conformance pass across the matrix for the eleventh consecutive day. Mistral's Thursday press note reported the GA cut enabled by the parallel Thursday CVE-2026-46341 patch shipping in Workflows v1.18.7 ahead of the rolling vendor-cohort default mid-June commitment, and that AWS Bedrock Agent Registry — the sixth orchestrator vendor — entered private-preview interop testing against the matrix Thursday afternoon with a public-preview target landing inside the first week of June. The Decoder separately reported the Mistral Workflows tenancy crossed 415 enterprise customers on the Thursday GA print (from Sunday's 394 weekend close), with the seven sovereign-cloud central-government reference cohort holding unchanged (France DGFiP, Germany Bundesagentur fuer Arbeit, UK HMRC, Italy Agenzia delle Entrate, Spain AEAT, Portugal Autoridade Tributaria, Belgium FOD Financien).
